kind.content: Advice across the full life of a company.
From the first shareholder agreement to the final sale, and every hard conversation in between.
Five practices. One standard of work.
Every matter is led by a named partner and scoped in writing before we start, with a fee you can plan around.
Acquisitions, disposals, joint ventures and shareholder agreements for mid-market companies and their owners.
Holding structures, succession planning and cross-border tax positions that hold up under scrutiny.
Commercial litigation and arbitration, led by partners who have argued in the courts they recommend.
Board evaluations, director duties, investigations and the quiet work of keeping a company defensible.
Lender negotiations, refinancing and turnaround plans before the pressure turns into a crisis.
Outcomes our clients can put a number on.
Sale of a family-owned logistics group to a strategic buyer
Refinancing a manufacturer through a covenant breach
facility reset with no equity dilution
Warranty claim against the seller of a software business
A one-page engagement letter: what we will do, who will do it and the fee for each phase.
Milestones, dates and owners in one shared plan, updated every week.
Every matter closes with a partner review of what went well and what we would change.
They told us what we did not want to hear, early enough for it to matter. Eighteen months later we closed the sale on our terms.
Talk to a partner this week.
A 30-minute first conversation is free and confidential. You will leave it knowing your options and what they cost.
Independent advisers in corporate law, finance and governance. Partner-led since 1998.
